edition.authority: Second Vatican Council; Pope Paul VI
edition.notes: The official Latin Acta presentation contains numbered articles 1-130 on printed pp. 97-133, followed by the appended declaration on revision of the calendar on printed pp. 133-134, the promulgation formula and date beginning on printed p. 134, and the papal and conciliar subscriptions and notarial attestations through printed p. 138.
edition.title: Constitutio de Sacra Liturgia Sacrosanctum Concilium

passages.context: The Constitution's complete numbered body, beginning with article 1 on printed p. 97 and ending with article 130 on printed p. 133 immediately before the distinct appended declaration on revision of the calendar. The promulgation formula follows the appendix on printed p. 134.
passages.notes: Article 130 appears on artifact and printed p. 133. The beginning, numbered sequence, and final boundary were checked against the exact Acta artifact; no complete diplomatic transcription or word-for-word image collation is claimed.

passages.context: The complete Latin article 2 and its source note 1 were directly inspected on printed pp. 97-98. The opening clause says that through the liturgy, especially in the divine Eucharistic sacrifice, « opus nostrae Redemptionis exercetur »; note 1 explicitly identifies the quotation as the « Secreta dominicae IX post Pentecostem », the Ninth Sunday after Pentecost super oblata.
passages.notes: Article 2 begins on artifact and printed p. 97, where note 1 also appears, and concludes on p. 98 before article 3. Its page images, OCR text, quotation, note, and boundaries were directly inspected in the exact Acta artifact. This verification does not claim a complete diplomatic transcription or word-for-word collation of the full pp. 97-138 constituent.

work.author: Second Vatican Council
work.description: The Second Vatican Council's Constitution on the Sacred Liturgy, solemnly promulgated by Pope Paul VI on 4 December 1963. It comprises articles 1-130 and the appended declaration on revision of the calendar; edition records distinguish the Latin Acta witness from dated Vatican web delivery states and translations.
work.title: Sacrosanctum Concilium
